premises.text: Robots are constrained by hardware costs and complexity
premises.evidence_span: As a result, robots are no longer constrained by these parts. They're instead constrained by the hardware.

premises.text: Affordable and accessible quality hardware can increase the pace of innovation in robotics
premises.evidence_span: if more people can afford and access quality hardware, then the pace of innovation can be massively increased.

premises.text: Modbot provides common building blocks for robot construction
premises.evidence_span: Modbot identifies the common building blocks found in all robots.

premises.text: Modbot allows for easy disassembly and reassembly of robotic components
premises.evidence_span: If you don't like what you've built, just disassemble and build something else.

premises.text: Modbot enables rapid prototyping through a phone app and cloud-based tools
premises.evidence_span: You can use our phone app to do hardware programming on the fly, record keyframes, and repeat sequences wirelessly.

premises.text: Modbot's integrated design reduces costs and improves efficiency
premises.evidence_span: we've managed to reduce the cost of an industrial equivalent by about one-tenth.

premises.text: Modbot aims to democratize robot building for small businesses and individuals
premises.evidence_span: Small businesses will be able to afford to build entire production lines locally.

value.text: Robots can be built more easily and affordably by a wider range of people
value.evidence_span: we believe that ModBot can do the same for robots.

notes: No separate premises for crowdfunding campaign as it does not change the core value proposition.
